title: Q2
description:
Read: Psa 40:6-8, Exo 21:5-6

The Hebrew is "my ears you have opened." The Greek, which the letter follows, is "a body you have prepared for me." A servant who loves his master has his ear bored and serves for life.

a) What does each wording contribute, and why does the argument need the body and not only the opened ear?
